scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,site,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin-panel"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w admin-panel && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w admin-panel && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w admin-panel && npm run lint -w frontend
